definitions.explanation: A method or system of cultivating crops, such as organic or traditional farming.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{農法|のうほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{試|ため}す→試す：02130_tamesu⟧。
examples.english: To try a new farming method.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{農法|のうほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{守|まも}られている→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
examples.english: In this region, traditional farming methods have been preserved.

examples.japanese: ⟦{農薬|のうやく}→農薬：04295_nouyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}わない→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{有機|ゆうき}→有機：03643_yuuki⟧{農法|のうほう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手間|てま}→手間：03554_tema⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧な⟦{作物|さくもつ}→作物：02823_sakumotsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作|つく}れる→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Organic farming that uses no pesticides takes effort, but it produces safe crops.

notes:
Compound of {農|のう} (agriculture) + ⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧ (method). Refers to a system or approach to cultivation rather than a single task.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{有機|ゆうき}→有機：03643_yuuki⟧{農法|のうほう}: organic farming
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧{農法|のうほう}: natural farming (without chemicals or tillage)
- ⟦{伝統|でんとう}{的|てき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧な{農法|のうほう}: traditional farming methods

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{栽培|さいばい}→栽培：13108_saibai⟧: cultivation; growing — the act of raising plants, not the overall method
- ⟦{農業|のうぎょう}→農業：01491_nougyou⟧: agriculture; farming — the whole industry or occupation
